scdm_description: Cellular Cancer Biology Imaging Research (CCBIR), an NCI Division of Cancer Biology program. Develops and tests imaging technologies at the cellular and organ scales, driven by questions in cancer biology.
scdm_funding_source: National Cancer Institute (Division of Cancer Biology)

scdm_description: Cancer Systems Biology Consortium (CSBC), an NCI Division of Cancer Biology program. Brings together cancer biologists, engineers, mathematicians, physicists, and oncologists to apply systems biology approaches to fundamental questions in tumor biology, treatment response, and patient outcome. Successor to the Integrative Cancer Biology Program (ICBP).
scdm_funding_source: National Cancer Institute (Division of Cancer Biology)

scdm_description: Human Tumor Atlas Network (HTAN), an NCI Cancer Moonshot program launched in 2018. Constructs three-dimensional atlases of the cellular, morphological, molecular, and spatial features of human tumors and their microenvironments over time, from precancerous lesions through advanced disease. Phase 2 launched in fall 2024.
scdm_funding_source: National Cancer Institute (Division of Cancer Biology, Division of Cancer Prevention, Division of Cancer Treatment and Diagnosis, Center for Strategic Scientific Initiatives)

scdm_description: Integrative Cancer Biology Program (ICBP), an NCI Division of Cancer Biology program that ran 2004-2014, centered on Centers for Cancer Systems Biology (CCSB) applying integrative/systems approaches and mathematical and computational modeling to cancer research. Its funded centers became the founding members of the Cancer Systems Biology Consortium (CSBC).
scdm_funding_source: National Cancer Institute (Division of Cancer Biology)

scdm_description: Metastasis Research Network (MetNet), an NCI Division of Cancer Biology program. Supports research advancing a comprehensive, whole-body, systems-level understanding of cancer metastasis.
scdm_funding_source: National Cancer Institute (Division of Cancer Biology)

scdm_description: National Cancer Institute, the U.S. federal agency for cancer research and training. Used in MC2/CCKP data as a direct attribution for resources funded by NCI that are not tied to one of its specific named consortium programs.

consortium_name: NCI Clinical and Translational Exploratory/Developmental Studies
scdm_name: NCI Clinical and Translational Exploratory/Developmental Studies
scdm_description: An NCI grant mechanism (R21) supporting exploratory and developmental clinical and translational cancer research: early-stage, higher-risk studies in diagnosis, treatment, imaging, symptom/toxicity, and prevention, including correlative studies associated with clinical trials.

Patient-Derived Models of Cancer (PDMC) Consortium, an NCI Division of Cancer Biology program. Supports the generation and characterization of patient-derived cancer models (e.g. organoids, xenografts) and the biological principles governing their behavior, including response to cancer therapeutics.
scdm_funding_source: National Cancer Institute (Division of Cancer Biology)

scdm_description: Physical Sciences-Oncology Network (PS-ON), an NCI Division of Cancer Biology program. Fosters the convergence of physical-sciences approaches and perspectives (physics, engineering, quantitative methods) with cancer research.
scdm_funding_source: National Cancer Institute (Division of Cancer Biology)

scdm_description: The nonprofit research organization that operates the Multi-Consortia Coordinating (MC2) Center and the Cancer Complexity Knowledge Portal (CCKP). Used in MC2/CCKP data as the attribution for resources contributed directly by the coordinating center rather than by one of the specific NCI-funded consortium programs it serves.
scdm_funding_source: National Cancer Institute (MC2 Center coordinating center award)

scdm_description: Cancer Tissue Engineering Collaborative (TEC), an NCI Division of Cancer Biology program. Supports the development and characterization of state-of-the-art biomimetic tissue-engineered technologies for cancer research.
scdm_funding_source: National Cancer Institute (Division of Cancer Biology)
